howToRun.live: For setup 'files', write each input.files entry into the directory named in input.invoke (for example /tmp/rca-02/k8s-events.txt). Run claude -p "<input.invoke>" --permission-mode plan --output-format json and compare .result with expect.
howToRun.deterministic: Run input.command from AI-SDLC/ and compare exit code, stdout and stderr with expect.

matching.rootCauseMustMention: claims a grader checks in section 7 (semantic, not literal)
matching.candidatesMustInclude: hypotheses that must appear in section 6 with the stated verdict
matching.sections: headings that must all be present
